displayName: UE4 tiled deferred local-light radial evaluator
description: Compute pass that reconstructs a shaded world position, iterates a per-tile local-light list, reads dynamically indexed light position and inverse radius, evaluates native finite-radius attenuation, and accumulates the result into a typed 2D UAV.

checks.meaning: The verified family dynamically indexes the local-light direction, spot, and auxiliary parameter array.
The verified family dynamically indexes light position, inverse radius, color, and type data.
A uint buffer supplies the packed per-tile light-list entry.
The verified Remake variants use an 80-byte structured tile/light-list record.
The pass accumulates deferred local-light radiance into one typed 2D output.
The verified family shades a 16-by-16 screen tile per compute group.
A per-light vector is formed from the reconstructed world position and dynamically indexed light position.
The inverse light radius is squared before multiplying squared world-space distance.
The local-light path contains the native one-minus-square finite-radius attenuation polynomial.
A dynamically indexed light-type parameter selects the radial attenuation bypass path.

runtimeContract.specializedVerifierRequirement: The generic descriptor is discovery-only. Automatic transformation requires exactly one register-consistent position/distance/radius/polynomial chain and zero structural exceptions from the specialized verifier.
transformationSafety: Preserve zero attenuation at normalized radius one unless the engine light bounds and tile-list culling are also changed.
Do not infer a larger physical light radius by changing inverse radius in this shader alone.
Do not alter contact shadows, shadow-map attenuation, spot attenuation, IES evaluation, BRDF terms, AO, or GI as part of a radial-falloff transformation.
Flag any shader with multiple compatible radial blocks, mismatched dynamic indices, changed CB3/CB4 layouts, or changed output/dispatch bindings for manual review.
